title: Classification
description: company-profile/{company_id}/classification.json: the stored answer of /classify. Every other skill reads `tags` to decide which catalog rules apply.

tags.description: Empty means the product neither handles user content nor sells online: nothing in scope applies. intermediary: hosts, stores or transmits third-party content. smi: social media intermediary. ssmi: 50 lakh or more registered users in India, or an order under rule 6 applying rule 4. sgi: lets users create or share synthetically generated audio, image or video. ecom, ecom-marketplace, ecom-inventory: e-commerce entity and its model.

registered_users_india.description: Leave out if unknown; never guess

basis.description: code: seen in the repo. user: the user said so. unconfirmed: neither, so the tag is an assumption

unknowns.description: Questions nobody could answer, and what was assumed
